title: How long does it take to build a mobile app?
desc: A simple app usually takes 4 to 8 weeks, while more complex apps can take 3 months or longer. We share a clear timeline after understanding your requirements.

title: Do you build for both iOS and Android?
desc: Yes. We build native apps as well as cross-platform apps, depending on what suits your budget and goals.

title: What does it cost to develop an app?
desc: The cost depends on features, design and platforms. Contact us for a free quote tailored to your project.
